correctness.rationale: Exact independent SymPy construction of M=A_R A_L^2 verifies det M=-d^2u, both Schur/Jury inequalities and the x0,x1,x2 rational return equations. The strict LLR condition enforces B>Bmin while J+>0 enforces B<Bmax. Expanding H(Bmax-Bmin) at L=1+d+t proves for u≤u*<3 all nonconstant t coefficients negative and the constant ≤0. The rational U(d) diverges at both endpoints, and its derivative sign polynomial has one positive root by Descartes; this gives unique global min. The proof’s two parameter perturbations cover every u>u* and keep all saddle, Jury and itinerary signs strict; the exact example L=7/5,d=1/3,B=8/3,u=3 checks. Numeric root check only corroborates an exact algebraic boundary; finite tests alone would not prove the all-real iff.
